name: gridtrace
description: Atlas — Find where energy disappears, explain why, and prioritize what to inspect.

scripts.dev:worker: uv run --python 3.11 --package gridtrace-worker python -m gridtrace_worker.main scheduler
scripts.setup: pnpm py:sync && pnpm db:up && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed
scripts.setup:production: pnpm py:sync && pnpm db:up && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:ingest-production
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && uv run --python 3.11 --package gridtrace-api python -m alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:seed: uv run --python 3.11 --package gridtrace-worker python -m gridtrace_worker.main seed
scripts.db:export-production: uv run --python 3.11 --package gridtrace-worker python -m gridtrace_worker.main export-production-csv
scripts.db:ingest-production: pnpm db:setup-production && uv run --python 3.11 --package gridtrace-worker python -m gridtrace_worker.main ingest-production
scripts.db:ensure-demo-user: uv run --python 3.11 --package gridtrace-worker python -m gridtrace_worker.main ensure-demo-user
scripts.demo:reset: uv run --python 3.11 --package gridtrace-worker python -m gridtrace_worker.main refresh-demo
scripts.generate:contracts: uv run --python 3.11 --package gridtrace-api python scripts/export-openapi.py && pnpm --filter @gridtrace/contracts run generate
